description:
The same perp markets on two DEXs side by side, from their public data: decibel,
        hyperliquid, lighter, gmx. Per market: price, hourly funding in bps (positive = longs
        pay shorts) and annualized at the current rate (x 8760, not a forecast), open interest
        in USD, price and funding gaps, and cheaper_to_hold_long (null for GMX: its rate is
        the paying side's only, without the borrow fee). market: one symbol such as "BTC"
        (empty = all). sort: funding_gap (biggest first), price_gap, oi, name, funding_a,
        funding_b. a="all": every DEX in one table, one row per market listed on at least two,
        with cheapest_long (never GMX) and funding_spread (sort: funding_spread, oi, name,
        venues). Every answer says when each DEX's data is from. Data, not advice. No
        registration needed.
name: compare_markets
